name: MM-RLHF
description: A large-scale dataset of 120k human-annotated preference comparison pairs for aligning multimodal large language models with human preferences, improving reward model quality and alignment efficiency.
reputation: A recent multimodal preference dataset that is mainly used in alignment research, with growing interest but limited long-term benchmark adoption so far.
notes: Dataset supports improved reward modeling and alignment algorithms; includes critique-based reward model and dynamic reward scaling; open-sourced with benchmarks.
